Northern Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Campbell Soup Company (CPB) by 46.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 39,165 shares of the packaged foods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.88 million, down from 73,810 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northern Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Campbell Soup Company for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $12.26 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.00% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $40.76. About 934,396 shares traded. Campbell Soup Company (NYSE:CPB) has declined 25.74% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.29% the S&P500.
